e6_research_question: Can a cryptographically genuine source/challenge/history-bound SSHSIG signed receipt still be replayed, and replaced with a new same-admin signed receipt, without externally anchored signer identity and independently stored monotonic history?

proof_boundaries.meaning: signature over exact PR HEAD and immutable manifest bytes
one-time challenge from independent nonce authority cannot be verified by a local copy alone
signed previous receipt digest must match externally retained immutable predecessor
candidate signer public key must be OOB authenticated as independent, not merely match same-admin allowlist
revocation, nonce and key epoch floors survive R5Q full local rollback
genuine separation/quorum/owner decision required before any native admission

local_proofs_expected: true Ed25519 SSHSIG verifies exact received canonical receipt
tampered receipt without resigning fails true OpenSSH verification
wrong SSHSIG namespace fails true OpenSSH verification
wrong source, challenge or previous receipt SHA fail binding checks
local spent nonce list detects replay if unchanged
second process without retained spent history accepts same local signed receipt again
same admin can genuinely sign re-bound receipt again without independently authenticated witness
true R5Q rollback defeats local-only monotonic spent ledger
